english.note: Use this when someone or something passes so quickly that it is only briefly or unclearly perceived.
Use this when scenery or another visible thing passes by so quickly that it is seen only briefly.

examples.english: I only saw the bus flick past in front of me.
examples.traditional: 我淨係見到架巴士喺眼前一閃而過。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gin3 dou2 gaa3 baa1 si2 hai2 ngaan5 cin4 jat1 sim2 ji4 gwo3

examples.english: I saw the car flash past me so quickly that I couldn't read its number plate.
examples.traditional: 架車喺我面前一閃而過，我都睇唔清車牌。
examples.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 jat1 sim2 ji4 gwo3 ngo5 dou1 tai2 m4 cing1 ce1 paai4
